assumptions: inputs are the variables x0..x(n-1) only
no free constants: 0 and 1 are not available unless built by gates
no free complemented inputs: NOT xi is not available unless built
only gate is binary NAND; fan-in exactly two; ordered pairs; repetition allowed (NAND(v,v) = NOT v)
unlimited fanout: computed signals may be reused by any later gates (DAG sharing)
output may be any input or computed signal; size = number of NAND gates
truth tables are bit masks over assignments a in [0, 2**n), bit i of a = value of xi
model.scope: Exact finite result for the stated (n, s) and caps only. No all-n, asymptotic, superpolynomial, or P-vs-NP claim is made or implied. A long explicit certificate here does not rule out a different short certificate.

comparison.note: Grouping replaces one row per description with one row per distinct computed truth table, but soundness still needs coverage of every description: either the certificate lists every covered ID (so its size still grows with the number of descriptions) or the checker re-enumerates and re-evaluates every description itself (exponential checker work). Neither makes it automatically a polynomial-size NP certificate with a polynomial-time checker.
